subject: Post-demo: token economics snapshot & PO timing for pilot
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Feng <jordan.feng@maplehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap & ask — token economics snapshot and PO timing

Jordan — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap from our side and a simple set of asks so procurement can move this forward: 

Key numbers we heard on the call (your confirmation needed):
- Expected peak Q1 usage (in pilot): ~4–6M tokens/month (inference-heavy workflows during peak hours)
- Baseline monthly: ~1.2–1.8M tokens/month
- Expected growth if pilot expands: 10–20% month-over-month after month 2

Pricing and procurement assumptions we used in the demo:
- Reference unit: $/1M tokens (target you mentioned being comfortable with today): $75–$95 per 1M tokens depending on SLA/retention
- Pilot structure we proposed: 3-month pilot (reserved pool) with an option to convert to Dedicated after month 3
- PO threshold for self-service procurement we typically see: $25k–$75k depending on org approvals (we can size the initial commit to sit under procurement routing you prefer)

Asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm the monthly corridor you expect for the pilot (low/expected/high numbers above).
2) Confirm procurement's PO approval threshold and typical lead time (e.g., 2–6 weeks).
3) If the $/1M token target range above looks off, share the target number and we will re-surface an updated pricing sheet.

I attached a one-page snapshot of the proposed SOW and a pricing worksheet for the three-tier pilot (attached: pricing_by_tier.xlsx, Maple_SOW_v1.pdf). Once you confirm the corridor + PO threshold we will:
- Lock the pilot pricing in a short SOW (v1 attached)
- Share a DocuSign-ready SOW and our procurement contacts for PO routing
- Kick off security questionnaire items needed for the PO (SOC2 evidence, data retention notes)

Thanks — I’ll follow up Tuesday if I don’t hear back.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0163

Attachments: Maple_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW stub), pricing_by_tier.xlsx (pricing matrix), security_questionnaire.pdf (evidence checklist)
From: Jordan Feng <jordan.feng@maplehealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Rhodes <tim.rhodes@maplehealth.com>, procurement@maplehealth.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & ask — token economics snapshot and PO timing

Olga — thanks for the write-up and the attachments. Quick clarifications from our side: 

Confirmed corridor (pilot):
- Low: 0.9M tokens/mo (early days, limited to two workflows)
- Expected: 3.8M tokens/mo (primary workflows live, regular traffic)
- High: 7.5M tokens/mo (if we enable additional caching use-cases)

Procurement info:
- PO approval threshold for our BU (Health Insights): $50k — anything above that routes to central procurement (expect ~4–6 week lead time).
- For pilot we want to keep the initial contract under $50k to avoid central routing.

Pricing target:
- We were hoping to see something closer to $70/1M tokens at the pilot scale if SLA is standard and logs retention is 30 days. If Dedicated/SLA is required, we understand that rises.

Next steps on our side:
- Tim (copied) will confirm the exact BU PO routing and can share a contact in procurement for direct coordination.
- We should get a short SOW + an updated pricing row at $70/1M to review with the budget owner.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Jordan
Head of ML Platforms, Maple Health
jordan.feng@maplehealth.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Feng <jordan.feng@maplehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Tim Rhodes <tim.rhodes@maplehealth.com>, procurement@maplehealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & ask — token economics snapshot and PO timing

Jordan / Tim — great, thanks for the clear corridor and the PO threshold. Plan below: 

1) We will prepare an updated SOW that preserves the pilot scope but includes a pricing row at $70/1M (pilot SLA, 30-day logs).
2) We will cap the pilot SOW value to fall under $50k so it stays within BU approval — suggested structure: 3-month pilot billed monthly, up to 4.5M tokens/month expected average (this keeps the 3-month spend ~ $9450/mo at $70/1M; total ~ $28k).
3) If you want an optional buffer to cover high months, we can add an optional burst band that’s non-binding and charged at the high-tier rate.
4) DocuSign + PO path: we’ll send a DocuSign-ready SOW (link below) and can also provide a short PO template your procurement team can use.

Action items (owners and ETA):
- OLGA: Update SOW + pricing row and issue DocuSign package by EOD Wed (2027-04-21).
- Karthik: confirm available pilot capacity and whether we need a Dedicated reservation for the pilot (Karthik to advise by Wed EOD).
- TIM (Maple): share procurement contact + PO routing notes (Tim to send by Wed).
- MONICA: start SOC2 evidence pull and share minimal items to attach to SOW (Monica to follow up by Fri).

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/74231/MAP-2027-011
DocuSign (placeholder): https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=example

If that all looks good I’ll send the updated package tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks — Olga

Attachments: pricing_by_tier.xlsx (updated planned row)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Feng <jordan.feng@maplehealth.com>, Tim Rhodes <tim.rhodes@maplehealth.com>, procurement@maplehealth.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & ask — token economics snapshot and PO timing

Looping in capacity ops / legal on the timeline — I’ll ping Markus (legal) and confirm whether the pilot needs a soft reservation or we can operate on hosted capacity for month 1–3. Quick note: hosted-server pilot kept under $50k is straightforward from a provisioning perspective.

—Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
